Energy & Inputs.title: Will Crude Oil reach a new all-time high by September 30?
Energy & Inputs.why_it_matters: Tail-risk bet (4% odds) on crude reach the strike. Closes in ~1mo. Would lift farm diesel and pass through to nitrogen fertilizer cost within a few months.

Energy & Inputs.title: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $85 in August?
Energy & Inputs.why_it_matters: Market pricing 62% odds crude will reach $85. Closes in 18d. Would lift farm diesel and pass through to nitrogen fertilizer cost within a few months.

Energy & Inputs.title: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (LOW) $60 in August?
Energy & Inputs.why_it_matters: Tail-risk bet (1% odds) on crude drop below $60. Closes in 18d. A move this low would ease diesel and nitrogen input cost pressure heading into side-dress and summer ops.

Energy & Inputs.title: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $110 in August?
Energy & Inputs.why_it_matters: Tail-risk bet (3% odds) on crude reach $110. Closes in 18d. Would lift farm diesel and pass through to nitrogen fertilizer cost within a few months.

Energy & Inputs.title: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (LOW) $75 in August?
Energy & Inputs.why_it_matters: Near coin-flip odds (50% YES) crude drop below $75. Closes in 18d. A move this low would ease diesel and nitrogen input cost pressure heading into side-dress and summer ops.

Economy & Markets.title: Will the Fed decrease interest rates by 25 bps after the September 2026 meeting?
Economy & Markets.why_it_matters: Fed policy moves ripple through the dollar and farm lending -- 1% YES on this outcome.

Economy & Markets.title: Fed rate hike in 2026?
Economy & Markets.why_it_matters: 55% odds of a rate hike. Tighter policy strengthens the dollar and pressures grain export competitiveness.

Economy & Markets.title: Will no Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?
Economy & Markets.why_it_matters: 86% odds of a rate cut. Lower rates reduce operating loan and land interest carrying cost -- historically supportive of commodity prices via weaker dollar.

Economy & Markets.title: Will there be no change in Fed interest rates after the September 2026 meeting?
Economy & Markets.why_it_matters: Fed policy moves ripple through the dollar and farm lending -- 66% YES on this outcome.

Weather & Climate.title: Will a hurricane make landfall in the US in August?
Weather & Climate.why_it_matters: Hurricanes disrupt Gulf exports and can damage late-season crops across the South.
